title: Construction, verification, and coherence of the QOU $\mathrm{Frob}_p$ instance
html:
Construction, verification, and coherence of the QOU \mathrm{Frob}_p instance

This remark records the finite-place coherence checks, the Lean status, the downstream consumers, and the cross-prime coherence of the conj:qou-motivic-galois-instance construction.

Construction and verification

  • Compatibility verification. We perform two finite-place coherence checks on every (p, \text{atom}) cell. First, Galois-norm integrality holds: the trace N(\mathrm{Frob}_p) = \sum_{\sigma \in \mathrm{Gal}(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_{2p})/\mathbb{Q})} \sigma(\mathrm{Frob}_p) yields a rational integer (residual < 10^{-7}). Second, Weil purity holds at small primes: at p \in \{2, 3\}, the orbit-spread \max|\sigma(\mathrm{Frob}_p)| - \min|\sigma(\mathrm{Frob}_p)| remains below 10^{-10} for every atom, and the inferred weight w = 2 \log_p |\mathrm{Frob}_p| takes integer or near-integer values. At larger primes, the spread grows. The QOU motive remains mixed in general, consistent with the brane tower forming a sum across cohomology degrees.

  • Lean status: there is no instance. MotivicGaloisCharacter carries a single field, frobenius_at, and nothing in the Lake tree supplies it for the QOU substrate, so def:motivic-galois-character is not discharged here. The class once also carried almost_everywhere_nontrivial; that field was removed precisely because encoding it as a class field forced every instance either to prove it or to launder the perpetual obstruction through a bare axiom.

Downstream consumers

Were the instance in hand, theorems that carry def:motivic-galois-character as an [instance] hypothesis could consume it directly, and the motivic perpetual obstruction would become unconditional for the QOU substrate. That is the intended payoff, not a present fact: the instance is conjectural, so those theorems still carry the hypothesis.

What is unconditional is a narrower result on a different route: lean/QOU/LiftingDescent/MotivicPerpetualObstructionFromTrace.lean derives the obstruction from the prime-ideal-collapse invariant C = a_0(-1) + 2 a_1(-1), sorry-free, without going through a MotivicGaloisCharacter instance at all.

Coherence

Cross-prime coherence follows structurally from the Habiro theorem. Any two evaluations f|_{u = \zeta_{2p}} and f|_{u = \zeta_{2q}} extract from the same Habiro element and respect the natural Galois action on \mathbb{Q}(\mu_\infty). The deeper \ell-adic archimedean Weil/Deligne behaviour lies outside this construction.
